parameters.content:
Document Classification + Marksheet Extraction Pipeline

1. POST a PDF or image (raw binary body) to the webhook.
2. File type is detected (PDF / image / unsupported).
3. PDFs and images are sent to the external OCR server (POST /ocr, multipart field "file").
4. The extracted text is classified by an LLM chain against the documentTypes list.
   - Returns strict JSON: { document_type, confidence }.
5. "Is Marksheet?" checks the classified type against the 4 marksheet types
   (CBSE / GSEB / ICSC / College Marksheet).
   - TRUE  -> "Clean Marksheet Text" shrinks the OCR text (removes noise +
     caps length to stay under Groq TPM limit), then "Extract Marksheet Data"
     runs a second LLM call and returns structured marksheet JSON.
   - FALSE -> the plain classification JSON is returned.

Setup needed:
- Groq credential (on "Groq Chat Model" and "Groq Extract Model").
- OCR server URL in the "Call OCR Server" HTTP node (default: http://host.docker.internal:8000/ocr).

parameters.text:
=You are an expert OCR Document Classification System.

Your task is to classify a document using ONLY the OCR extracted text.

==============================
OCR TEXT
==============================

{{$json.extractedText}}

==============================
AVAILABLE DOCUMENT TYPES
==============================

{{$json.documentTypes}}

==============================
INSTRUCTIONS
==============================

Read the OCR extracted text carefully and determine the document type.

Step 1: Check against AVAILABLE DOCUMENT TYPES
• Review the OCR text for key identifiers such as document title, headings, issuing authority (Government, University, Board, Bank, Company), certificate names, structural markers, and specific keywords.
• If a matching document type exists in the provided list, select the MOST SPECIFIC one.

Step 2: Fallback Identification (If Type is Unknown or Not Listed)
• If the document does not match any type in AVAILABLE DOCUMENT TYPES, or if the provided list is empty, DO NOT return "Unknown".
• Use your domain knowledge to independently identify and assign the most accurate, standardized document category based on the content, structure, and context (e.g., "Driving License", "Utility Bill", "Tax Return", "Rental Agreement", etc.).

==============================
REFERENCE KEYWORD EXAMPLES
==============================

Resume: Curriculum Vitae, Professional Summary, Experience, Skills
Purchase Order: Purchase Order, PO Number, Supplier, Order Date
Invoice: Tax Invoice, GST, Invoice Number, Total Due
Receipt: Receipt, Payment Received, Amount Paid
Aadhaar Card: Government of India, Unique Identification Authority, UIDAI
PAN Card: Income Tax Department, Permanent Account Number
SSC / HSC Marksheet: Secondary / Higher Secondary Certificate, Board, Marks, Percentage
College Marksheet: Semester, University, SGPA, CGPA, Grade Card
Degree Certificate: Bachelor, Master, Doctorate, Awarded to
Bank Statement: Statement Period, Account Number, Debit/Credit, Opening Balance
Salary Slip: Pay Slip, Gross Salary, Net Salary, Deductions
Electricity Bill: Consumer ID, Units Consumed, Tariff, Due Date
Medical Report: Diagnosis, Patient Name, Lab Results, Hospital/Doctor
Contract / Agreement: Terms and Conditions, Parties, Witness, Signature

==============================
OUTPUT FORMAT
==============================

Return ONLY valid JSON. No conversational text or markdown explanation outside the JSON.

{
  "output": {
    "document_type": "<Identified Document Type>",
    "confidence": 0.95
  }
}

conditions.rightValue: CBSE Marksheet (Central Board of Secondary Education)
GSEB Marksheet (Gujarat Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board)
ICSC Marksheet (Indian Certificate of Secondary Education)
